leaderboard.description: Elo ratings (K=40, home adv 60); backs the model-argmax when edge over the margin-removed market >= 3%. No edge -> no bet.
leaderboard.name: Elo value edge

leaderboard.description: Always backs the margin-removed market favourite (highest implied probability). Baseline reference, not a claimed edge.
leaderboard.name: Market favourite (baseline)

leaderboard.description: Elo-based: back the 2-way leader when p_draw < 0.30 and max(p_home,p_away) >= 0.55; a draw loses (DNB rule).
leaderboard.name: Draw-No-Bet decisive

leaderboard.description: Always backs the margin-removed least-favoured team outcome (min of home/away implied probabilities; draw excluded). Tests the favourite-longshot bias on the pilot sample.
leaderboard.name: Market longshot probe (baseline)

predictions.body: Ratings are level (1500 vs 1500) - nothing separates the two yet. Our three-way model has Borussia Mönchengladbach 44%, draw 25%, Bayer 04 Leverkusen 31%. The market (margin-removed) implies Borussia Mönchengladbach 19%, draw 21%, Bayer 04 Leverkusen 60%. We are backing home - our model rates it +25 points against the market price, a clear value edge worth acting on. Getting it at 5.16 makes the risk worth taking on a level stake. Tip: HOME Paper trading only - not betting advice.
predictions.headline: Borussia Mönchengladbach v Bayer 04 Leverkusen: HOME

caveats: Community-entered results, not a DFL/governing-body official feed.
ODbL share-alike: derived database files must carry ODbL attribution.
Completed seasons are stated to no longer change; live seasons can.
sources.license_summary: Open Database License (ODbL) 1.0 - open, share-alike. Derivative databases must be ODbL-licensed with attribution. No auth, no key.

caveats: This repository has no provider account or API key; the connector is implemented but inactive until the operator supplies both.
Raw response bodies and bulk odds exports are local-only and must not be published through GitHub Pages or a public API.
The provider disclaims accuracy; event identity and official results still require independent reconciliation.
Bookmaker coverage and historical availability vary by sport, market, region and the date each feed was added.
sources.license_summary: Paid-plan contractual access. Historical odds are available only on paid usage plans. Current terms permit storage, UI display, research, derived values and model training, but prohibit selling or redistributing the raw data as a standalone feed.
sources.rate_limit: historical quota: 10 credits per region per market; plan-dependent

caveats: No live organizer permission or feed is bundled in this repository.
Synthetic contract tests are not real official outcomes.
sources.license_summary: No blanket licence. An organizer identity, written permission reference/date, source URL and authority attestation are mandatory before a result is treated as official.

caveats: No per-event odds timestamps: prices are batch-collected (Fri 17:00 UK for weekend fixtures, Tue 13:00 UK for midweek) - snapshots are window-close-inferred, never exact.
Pinnacle columns unreliable since 2025-07-23 per site notice; not used for market-average calculations here.
Derived data must not be redistributed; keep raw imports local (data/imports/) and out of the published site.
Residual legal risk: obtain explicit permission or a licensed alternative before scaling or any commercial use.
sources.license_summary: No open/public license found. Stated policy: free for private individuals only; NOT for commercial use or data-training products using automated bots/scrapers/AI. Treated as research-use-only with a human (non-bot) import step.
sources.rate_limit: n/a - automated retrieval is disallowed by source policy

caveats: Automated collection is NOT permitted. The collector module is disabled by default and raises PolicyError if auto mode is attempted.
Tipster claims on OLBG pages are unverified user content (ToU 5.4); imported tips stay 'pending' and never count to verified PnL.
No permissioned API exists; /api/ and /sports/ are robots-disallowed.
